name: RSX eight-speed cassette
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed weight for the eight-speed U-group 12–23T cassette: 12-13-14-15-17-19-21-23T. The 2007 trade table gives 278 g for this group and lists its tooth sequence on the same page. Lockring inclusion is assumed under the catalogue weight guidelines.
